title: Evidence that is not a JSON object is refused in each primary's own words
note: AUD-055, the remainder of AUD-047. canonical.json_object states once what a reader of evidence may take as an object (EO1 to EO3). The research ledger refuses a bundle that is not one, on replay, from its caller and in the context, and reads a bundle's outputs whatever else it holds (EO4 to EO10); the learned-model ledger refuses such a document (EO11), the governed model runs such a record (EO12), and the claim check reports such a citation broken (EO13). tests/test_evidence_objects.py holds each.

mutations.find: return doc if isinstance(doc, dict) else None
mutations.rationale: a JSON list or number is handed on as an object, and the first .get on it raises AttributeError out of every reader

mutations.rationale: evidence holding NaN or Infinity, which are not JSON, is read as an object
